whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Food Dude,

I noticed your restaurant has stellar 4.8★ reviews in Fraser Road, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online orders and table inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, digital menu, aur location guide integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fooddude

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Food Dude, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your 4.8-star review highlights in Fraser Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein!"
